content: RLS testing on Supabase uses pgTAP: 'create extension if not exists pgtap with schema extensions'. Tests live in supabase/tests/*.test.sql, run via 'supabase test db'. basejump supabase-test-helpers adds tests.create_supabase_user(), tests.authenticate_as(), tests.rls_enabled(). Allow/deny pattern: 'set local role authenticated; set local request.jwt.claim.sub = <uuid>' then assert both permitted and denied ops; Postgres default-denies when RLS is on with no matching policy. Use transaction rollback for isolation. rlsautotest can auto-generate tests.
